sources.title: Pytorch Image Models (timm) | timmdocs
sources.snippet: Pytorch Image Models (timm) `timm` is a deep-learning library created by Ross Wightman and is a collection of SOTA computer vision models, layers, utilities, optimizers, schedulers, data-loaders, augmentations and also training/validating scripts with ability to reproduce ImageNet training results.
